The '''combat chamber''' was a [[Flight simulator/Legends|holosimulator]] found on many [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] and was used to train various [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] in various missions. Some based on hypothetical scenarios, others based on historical events that happened throughout the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] history.

When a pilot enters the chamber they are given a choice of which craft to pilot, followed by which mission they wish to choose. Once the mission is chosen the device covers the player then gives a detailed briefing of the mission, followed by answers to questions provided by an [[Imperial briefing officer]]. Once the player completes two of four missions of a specific craft, they are rewarded a [[Bronze/Legends|bronze]] colored [[combat medallion]] of the respected craft, followed by a [[Silver/Legends|silver]] for completion of a third, and a [[Gold/Legends|gold]] medallion for all 4 missions belonging to the craft the pilot was using.

Pilots also had the option of replaying the various tour of duty missions they participated in the past, which included questions from a [[Priest (Secret Order of the Emperor)|Priest]] from the [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Secret Order of the Emperor]].

==Behind the scenes==
The '''combat chamber''' was a mode in the [[1994]] PC game [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]. It acted as the equivalent of playing "Historical Combat Missions" in [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']].
